arms.color_swap: Both candidate owners on each of 16 fresh 6x6 roots versus unchanged Unit-leaf/Unit-order foe; candidate and foe ordering are Unit.

changed_premise: Two disjoint generated 5x5 cohorts had positive aggregate effects but the owner/turn contrast moved from [+0.125,+0.375] to [-0.625,-0.500]. This cohort heterogeneity motivates one distinct-size replication; it does not identify a cause or justify global promotion.

contrasts.unknowns: For every paired root/owner slot, UNKNOWN arm reward is independently bounded [-1,+1]; report all-slot bounds, finite-only means, owner strata, seed strata and leave-one-seed-out envelope.

cost.cheaper_alternative: Source-only review cannot determine whether static-leaf choices transfer to 6x6 generated games; a half-size cohort would leave only four rules and two prefixes, too sparse for the owner/seed bounds. This one balanced 64-slot cohort is the smallest matched design retained.
cost.expected: Under twenty minutes for the single 64-game run, using the observed 233-second 5x5 64-game run as a baseline and conservatively allowing several-fold board-size overhead; producer enforces a frozen 2400-second cap. No splitting or extension.

decision: Widen static_v2 candidate scope to include this finite 6x6 regime only if aggregate and both owner all-slot lower bounds are strictly positive and every leave-one-seed-out lower bound is positive. Otherwise retain it as 5x5-only candidate. In either case no global price/default claim; report owner interaction and UNKNOWN bounds.
integrity: No training, solver, auxiliary checkout, reused rules/roots or price/default change.
Candidate arms differ only in leaf checkpoint; both use Unit ordering and the opponent is fixed Unit leaf/Unit ordering. Equal D3/8192-node/0.5-second/q0/TT0/root-window-off caps.
Preserve actual terminals, UNKNOWNs, complete histories, promotions, drops, costs and budget causes.
question: On eight disjoint unseen generated 6x6 rules, does the isolated static_v2 leaf-value effect remain positive across both candidate-owner/turn strata under the same D3 budget and fixed Unit opponent?

roots.selection: Fresh roots generated only from the listed new 6x6 rules and prefix-seed formula; candidate arms share each exact root and owner.

rules.selection: Eight previously unused 6x6 rule seeds. Pre-run scan across all 24 existing research plan.json files found no overlap. Two deterministic four-ply prefixes per rule. Rebuild every rule/profile/root and replay every result; no seed/root reuse.
